run_video_annotator_task: run the video annotator demo task locally using the dynamic inhouse configuration
generate_task_data_config: generate an extrapolated task_data.json config from unit and token sets values config files
build_video_annotator_dynamic: build the dynamic video annotator React app with optional force rebuild and post install script
launch_mephisto_task_run: launch a Mephisto task run using the operator with the provided mephisto configuration
wait_for_runs_then_shutdown: wait for all task runs to complete then shutdown the operator with periodic logging
